high.label: High risk
high.description: Access to secrets or to devices on your local network.

medium.label: Medium risk
medium.description: Data leaves this computer or the plugin reads your configuration.

low.label: Low risk
low.description: Limited to the plugin's own resources.

grant.allMethods: any HTTP method the plugin chooses (GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)

userOrigin.title: Connect to a server you enter in its setting “{{setting}}”
userOrigin.none: None until you enter one: DeckPilot then asks you to allow exactly that server, and asks again whenever the setting changes.
userOrigin.pathPrefix: You may limit it to a path (https://server/api).
userOrigin.privateNetwork: The server may be on your local network, only if you allow that for it separately.

privateNetwork.title: Connect to devices on your local network that you add
privateNetwork.detail: Only hosts you enter yourself in the plugin's settings; none until you add one. Plain HTTP is allowed for them.

network.title: Send data to and receive data from {{host}}
network.detail: HTTPS only. Methods: {{methods}}. Whatever the plugin can read can be sent to this host.

credentials.title: Use the secret “{{secret}}” that you store for it
credentials.detail: DeckPilot adds the secret to the plugin's requests, only to the hosts declared for this secret. The plugin gets a reference, not the value.

notifications.title: Show notifications
notifications.detailRouted: Prefixed with the plugin's name. On the desktop and in the status bar as you set it in the plugin's settings.

profile.titleBoth: Read the active profile and project
profile.detail: Id, key and name only; not their contents.

variables.title: Read the variable {{name}}
variables.detail: Sensitive variables of other owners and secret values are never readable.

storage.title: Store its own data
storage.titleQuota_one: Store up to {{count}} KB of its own data
storage.titleQuota_other: Store up to {{count}} KB of its own data
storage.detail: Raises the plugin's own storage above the default.

openUserOrigin.title: Open pages of the server you enter in its setting “{{setting}}” in your browser
openUserOrigin.detail: None until you enter a server and allow exactly it. Only https pages of that server, and only in an action you start (a key, a gesture or the app, or a workflow you start); never from a schedule, an event or startup. At most one every 2 seconds.

openUrl.title: Open links to {{host}} in your browser
openUrl.detail: Only https pages of this host, and only in an action you start (a key, a gesture or the app, or a workflow you start); never from a schedule, an event or startup. At most one every 2 seconds.

background.title: Run in the background
background.detailInterval_one: Timers at most every {{count}} second; the plugin's process keeps running.
background.detailInterval_other: Timers at most every {{count}} seconds; the plugin's process keeps running.

device.titleIcons: Stream Deck: use its own icons on keys
device.titleState: Stream Deck: change what its own keys show
device.detail: Only keys bound to the plugin's own actions.

list.none: This plugin asks for no permissions.

intro.install: Review what this plugin may do. Check each permission to consent to it; you can revoke permissions later in Installed.
intro.update: This version asks for more than you granted. Check each new or broadened permission to consent, decline the update, or cancel to decide later.
intro.enable: A plugin runs only with every permission it declares. Check each one that is not granted yet.

status.missing: {{missing}} of {{total}} permissions still need your consent.

review.enforced: The agent enforces these permissions on every call the plugin makes. The plugin runtime is experimental; only install plugins you trust.

profileRead.title: Read the active profile
profileRead.description: Reads the actions, workflows and layouts of the profile active on the device.

projectContext.title: Change the active project
projectContext.description: Switches the active project of the active profile, for example from a key.

machineResources.title: Read this computer's resource bindings
machineResources.description: Reads the paths, URLs and commands bound to project resources on this computer. They are never exported.

openExternal.title: Open applications, files and web pages
openExternal.description: Opens applications, files, folders and web pages with the programs your system chooses for them.

processExecution.title: Run programs on this computer
processExecution.description: Starts programs such as git, docker or a command you bound, with a time limit. Running your own commands must also be allowed in the module's settings.

processInspect.title: See which programs are running
processInspect.description: Reads the names of running programs, never their command lines or environment.

network.title: Send network requests
network.description: Sends HTTP requests. Requests to this computer or the local network must be allowed separately.

notifications.title: Show desktop notifications
notifications.description: Shows notifications on this computer and in the status bar.

variablesRead.title: Read shared variables
variablesRead.description: Reads shared and system variables while an action runs. Sensitive values stay hidden everywhere else.

credentials.title: Use stored credentials
credentials.description: Uses credentials stored on this computer by their name. Secrets are never part of a workflow or an export.
